_comment: Fiscal calendar configuration. Update these values and pass them as arguments to the Power Query functions. Power Query does not auto-read this file — it documents intent and is validated by scripts/validate_repo.py.

_coverage._comment: FactSales[OrderDateKey] spans 2017-07-01 .. 2020-06-15 (1461-row Date_data sheet confirms the fiscal calendar, but the FACT max is 2020-06-15, not the 2020-06-30 month end implied by data/summary.json's month_key granularity). fiscalYearStartDate must be a WeekStartDay on or before factMinDate, or the Calendar relationship matches nothing and every Calendar-bound visual renders blank.
_coverage._factSpanSource: Verified 2026-09-29 via pandas.read_excel(usecols=['OrderDateKey']) -> min 20170701, max 20200615, 121253 rows. Re-verify with scripts/inspect_adventureworks.py; a full read takes ~114s so it is not re-run on every validation.
_coverage._numberOfYearsRationale: numberOfYears=4 generates FY2018..FY2021 so the calendar extends past the data (good hygiene, and the slicer offers a future FY). FY2021 holds 0 fact days, so Power BI renders no FY2021 row in the Annual Growth Trajectory table. numberOfYears=3 would generate exactly the three populated years but would need changing at the next data load.

_notes.standard: Month-aligned calendar. Pass FiscalYearStartMonth (1-12) to fnCalendar.
_notes.445: 4+4+5 weeks per quarter. Each fiscal year = 52 weeks (53 in leap years). Anchor: nearest WeekStartDay on or before fiscalYearStartDate.
_notes.13period: 13 equal 4-week periods per year (52 weeks). FiscalQuarter column shows P01-P13.
